steps.description: The deal team executes a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) to open due diligence.

evidence.quote: Upon execution of a non-disclosure agreement (NDA), the deal team opens three parallel due diligence workstreams

steps.description: Legal reviews contracts and active litigation and produces a written due diligence report.

evidence.quote: Legal reviews contracts and active litigation
Each workstream must produce a written due diligence report.

steps.description: Finance builds the financial model and performs valuation and produces a written due diligence report.

evidence.quote: Finance builds the financial model and performs valuation
Each workstream must produce a written due diligence report.

steps.description: HR assesses the target's organizational structure and key-person risk and produces a written due diligence report.

evidence.quote: HR assesses the target's organizational structure and key-person risk
Each workstream must produce a written due diligence report.

steps.description: If Legal identifies litigation with a claimed value exceeding $5,000,000, the CFO must sign off before the deal team may proceed to the Letter of Intent.

evidence.quote: If the Legal workstream identifies outstanding litigation with a claimed value exceeding $5,000,000, the CFO must sign off before the deal team may proceed to the Letter of Intent.

steps.description: The deal team proceeds to a Letter of Intent only after all three written reports are complete and any required CFO sign-off is obtained.

evidence.quote: The deal team may not proceed to a Letter of Intent until all three written reports are complete.

steps.description: The Board reviews deal terms and approves before any definitive agreement is signed.

evidence.quote: Board approval is required before any definitive agreement is signed. The Board reviews the deal terms after the Letter of Intent is executed.

steps.description: The definitive agreement is signed only after Board approval is obtained.

evidence.quote: Board approval is required before any definitive agreement is signed.
